name: BigCommerce
tagline: BigCommerce is an enterprise ecommerce platform powering thousands of online stores, offering built-in SEO tools, multi-channel selling, and headless commerce capabilities. Its AI features assist with product descriptions, personalised recommendations, and conversion optimisation. It's a strong choice for high-growth brands that have outgrown Shopify and need more native flexibility.
